responsibility: This header defines the public C API for embedding GCC as a JIT compiler. It declares the opaque handle types, option enums, object model, context/result lifecycle, type/function/block/value construction routines, compilation and compile-to-file entrypoints, diagnostics and timers, asm support, and reflection/version feature macros that form libgccjit’s stable external ABI. It is the canonical public interface specification for the library.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/libgccjit.cc, which implements the API, and gcc/jit/docs/_build/texinfo/libgccjit.texi, which documents it, this same-stem header is the installable public C interface that declares the opaque types, enums, feature macros, and gcc_jit_* function prototypes forming libgccjit’s external ABI.
